verdict.rationale: HMRC's public employer-registration page says you can check when to expect your registration letter from HMRC, which gives founders some public visibility into an application's timing. It is an expected-timeline check, not a lookup of the specific filing's or case's status. Online management of Corporation Tax happens through the signed-in business tax account rather than public pages. Missing for 10: case-specific status lookup on public pages, status visibility for filings (e.g. CT/VAT returns) and other applications such as VAT registration, documentation of what the timeline checker shows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
